data.long_description:
Beautifully Furnished Apartment for Sale

Looking for a comfortable and stylish place to call home? This fully furnished apartment offers everything you need for a cozy and convenient lifestyle. Whether you're planning a short-term stay or a long-term rental, this unit is an excellent choice.

Key Features:

Tastefully Furnished
The apartment is fully furnished with modern, high-quality furniture, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Every detail has been thoughtfully designed to ensure comfort and style.

Spacious Layout
Enjoy the generous space this apartment offers, perfect for relaxing or entertaining guests.

Two Bathrooms
With two well-maintained bathrooms, you’ll have the convenience and privacy you need.

Open Kitchen
The open kitchen design is both functional and stylish, making cooking and dining a pleasure.

Community View
The apartment features a lovely community view, adding to the serene and peaceful vibe of the space.

Prime Location

Low Rise Building on the Park
The building is located right on the park, offering easy access to green spaces for outdoor activities or a relaxing stroll.

Supermarket Under the Building
For your convenience, there’s a supermarket located right under the building, making daily errands quick and hassle-free.

This apartment is a perfect blend of comfort, style, and practicality. Don’t miss out on this excellent rental opportunity!
